info.title: agenteam account HTTP API
info.description: D07 B04 adapter surface. Production app binding and real Profile/PG/browser/process integration require the later assembly stage. No public registration, role-management, account-deletion or device API. Every JSON object is strict: unknown/duplicate keys, trailing JSON and non-UTF-8 fail. No permissive CORS. Canonical Host and browser Origin/Fetch-Metadata are checked before routing or reading bodies. All success and error responses are no-store/nosniff/no-referrer.

get.description: Requires a current administrator on every request and again in the domain transaction. Returns only invitations whose expiry is later than one database cutoff captured by the list statement, with each latest accepted delivery task and its current attempt facts. A local three-second facade budget covers current authorization, locks and the single list statement; it excludes prior HTTP authentication and response encoding.

get.description: GET only, no request body. Requires a current administrator before dispatch and again in the same read transaction. A maximum three-second budget starts before HTTP authentication and inherits earlier cancellation. HEAD and other methods return 405 with Allow: GET. No CSRF write token or Idempotency-Key is required. Current state is not a command receipt and does not grant retry authority.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exactly one canonical deployment origin; null, missing, multiple values and different origins fail before routing/body reads. Forwarded headers never establish it.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Signed created_at/id keyset, bound to System scope, resource/filter and descending order. Limit is not part of the binding. Never grants authority.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Canonical decimal query value. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one strong quoted positive decimal User version. No weak tag, wildcard, whitespace, list, zero, or int64 overflow.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: One bytes=start-end, bytes=start-, or bytes=-suffix range; checked int64 arithmetic. Multiple ranges are rejected with 416.

Channel uses the persisted current attempt when present and the current configured route before an attempt. sent means SMTP accepted or recovery log durably wrote; unknown may have delivered and a retry may duplicate it.

InvitationDelivery.description: Latest accepted invitation task across all resend and manual retry roots, ordered by command completed_at then job_id descending. accepted_at is the recorded final transaction completion time, not a commit sequence or delivery time. channel and attempt_result reflect only the persisted current attempt and are null when not recorded. retry_wait may retain an unknown result; legacy processing projects unknown. sent means SMTP acceptance or a durable backend log write, not inbox arrival.

attempts.description: Persisted claim count, not a count of actual sends.

channel.description: Compatibility summary only: exact current attempt channel when present; otherwise current singleton configured selects smtp or backend_log, independently of enabled. It is not evidence of an actual attempt or a promise of the next route.

created_at.description: Intent creation time, not command acceptance, enqueue or delivery time.

attempt_channel.description: Only the exact current attempt channel, or null. Never inferred from current configuration or a previous attempt.

attempt_result.description: Only the exact current attempt terminal result, or null before a terminal result. sent proves SMTP acceptance or durable restricted-log output, not inbox delivery.

MailJobManagement.description: Safe current-administrator management facts. Nine fields are required; only reason may be omitted. Old processing maps to unknown and may have no recorded attempt. retry_wait may retain an unknown attempt result; the next claim replaces current attempt. A read is neither a write receipt nor permission to retry.

MailJobManagementList.description: Descending intent created_at and job_id, with an independently signed mail-job-management cursor. Defaults to 25 items. Each page is a statement snapshot; separate pages do not share a snapshot.
